```{r setup, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)

qa  <- params$qa
cfg <- params$cfg

# Safe accessor: returns NULL instead of erroring when a field is missing
# or its parent is not a list.
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
safe <- function(expr) tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) NULL)
```

## Configuration

```{r}
cfg_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  Setting = c(
    "study_name", "location", "country",
    "location_ids", "start_year", "end_year",
    "disease_code", "include_estimated_cases",
    "env_variables", "species_filter", "max_lag_months", "db_path"
  ),
  Value = c(
    cfg$study_name %||% "(missing)",
    cfg$location    %||% "(missing)",
    cfg$country     %||% "(missing)",
    if (length(cfg$location_ids)) paste(cfg$location_ids, collapse = ", ")
      else "(name-based resolution)",
    as.character(cfg$start_year %||% NA),
    as.character(cfg$end_year   %||% NA),
    if (is.null(cfg$disease_code)) "(none)" else cfg$disease_code,
    as.character(isTRUE(cfg$include_estimated_cases)),
    paste(cfg$env_variables %||% character(), collapse = ", "),
    if (is.null(cfg$species_filter)) "(all)"
      else paste(cfg$species_filter, collapse = ", "),
    as.character(cfg$max_lag_months %||% NA),
    cfg$db_path %||% "(not set)"
  )
)
cfg_tbl |> gt::gt() |> gt::tab_header(title = "Analysis configuration")
```

## Table inventory

```{r}
if (is.data.frame(qa$tables) && nrow(qa$tables) > 0) {
  qa$tables |> gt::gt() |> gt::tab_header(title = "Rows returned by each query")
} else {
  cat("_No table inventory available._")
}
```

## Species present in vector query

```{r}
sp <- qa$species
if (is.data.frame(sp) && nrow(sp) > 0) {
  sp |> gt::gt() |> gt::tab_header(title = "Vector species present")
} else {
  cat("**No vector rows returned.** Verify `species_filter` and `location_ids`.")
}
```

## Species filter coverage

```{r}
sp <- qa$species
if (!is.null(cfg$species_filter) && is.data.frame(sp) && nrow(sp) > 0) {
  present <- tolower(sp$species_name)
  tibble::tibble(
    filter_value = cfg$species_filter,
    matched      = vapply(cfg$species_filter,
                          \(v) any(grepl(tolower(v), present, fixed = TRUE)),
                          logical(1))
  ) |> gt::gt() |> gt::tab_header(title = "Species filter coverage")
} else {
  cat("_Species filter coverage not applicable._")
}
```

## Environment variables

```{r}
ev <- qa$environment_vars
if (is.data.frame(ev) && nrow(ev) > 0) {
  ev |> gt::gt() |> gt::tab_header(
    title = "Environment variables present in fact_environment"
  )
} else {
  cat("_No environment variable summary available._")
}
```

## Monthly case counts

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
mc <- qa$monthly_cases
if (is.data.frame(mc) && nrow(mc) > 0) {
  library(ggplot2)
  print(
    ggplot(mc, aes(x = month_start, y = case_count)) +
      geom_line(color = "#1E40AF") +
      geom_point(color = "#1E40AF", size = 1) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Cases / month",
           title = "Monthly case counts (post-filter)") +
      theme_minimal()
  )
} else {
  cat("_No observed case rows present._ ",
      "This is expected if the CDM carries vector, environment, ",
      "resistance, and bionomics data only; case-based analyses are contextual.\n")
}
```
